posts.text: One of the more interesting claims from Sentinel is that they're selling it as a more privacy-focused alternative to AI filtering. Everything is done on-printer. Although, they did admit they'd have to update the firmware to keep up with trends, and that could become government-mandated.
posts.summary: Notes privacy trade-offs in gun-filtering software design
